h: Main Street, down to the marina
p: Main Street is Bangor's main shopping drag, running from the railway station at the top of town down to the seafront and the marina, so 1-3 Main Street puts you right where the action is. The train from Belfast takes around half an hour and drops you at the top of the same street, which makes Bangor an easy day out from the city.

There's a family side for the kids and a separate 18+ area for the cash-prize machines, so check the signs as you go in. For everyone else in the group, the seafront is the place to be: Pickie Fun Park has its famous giant swan pedal boats and a big play area, and the marina is lovely for a walk past the boats. Castle Park, with the North Down Museum in the grounds of Bangor Castle, is a short walk inland. If you've got legs left, the North Down Coastal Path heads off along the shore towards Crawfordsburn, with lovely sea views over Belfast Lough on a clear day.
